facts.text: Southern Seminary does not participate in federal or state student aid loan or grant programs, relying instead on Cooperative Program funding and institutional scholarships.

sources.title: Tuition - The Southern Baptist Theological Seminary
sources.quote: Southern Seminary does not participate in any federal or state student aid programs involving loans or grants. Financial Aid at Southern consists of Cooperative Program funding, scholarships awarded through endowed aid, and a private loan opportunity.

facts.text: Students who belong to Southern Baptist Churches receive a discounted tuition rate supported by the denomination's Cooperative Program.

sources.title: Tuition - The Southern Baptist Theological Seminary
sources.quote: Thanks to the generosity of Southern Baptists in contributing to the Cooperative Program, students who are members of Southern Baptist Churches receive a discounted tuition rate.
